headline: AFI Protocol website and documentation accessible, but deployed contract addresses not discoverable from standard sources

findings.text: Etherscan name-tag search for 'AFI' and 'afiUSD' returned no specific AFI Protocol contracts. Search operator site:etherscan.io did not yield targeted results.

Official deployments doc could not be accessed. Medium article referenced docs.afiprotocol.ai/technical-details/contract-addresses but docs.afiprotocol.xyz domain access blocked. No canonical deployments page located.

Audit links accessible (Quantstamp Dec 2025, Cantina Aug 2025). Quantstamp report at certificate.quantstamp.com and Cantina at cantina.xyz/portfolio confirmed valid but do not include deployed address tables in summary sections.

GitHub afiUSD repo (Artificial-Financial-Intelligence/afiUSD) contains Solidity source code and architecture documentation but no deployment artifacts (broadcast/ or deployments/ directories visible, no addresses.json or deployments.json files). README describes contract structure without listing deployed addresses.
Protocol claims Base, Ethereum, and Monad in chains list. Monad is not recognized as standard EVM chain as of knowledge cutoff; status unclear. Block explorer searches limited to accessible chains.
No factory contracts identified in initial corpora; cannot enumerate children.

rationale.verdict: Cannot determine deployed addresses. Website and GitHub confirm protocol exists with afiUSD vault architecture, but contract addresses are not surfaced from block explorers, GitHub deployment artifacts, or accessible documentation pages. Audit reports are valid but do not contain address tables. Monad chain status unclear. Off-chain metadata (docs, audits, GitHub) partially verified; on-chain state unverifiable without addresses.

evidence.shows: Official website confirms AFI Protocol operates afiUSD and afi-rwaUSD vaults on multiple chains, with Quantstamp and Cantina audit partnerships mentioned. References verification.afiprotocol.xyz and yield.afiprotocol.xyz applications.
Audit page lists Quantstamp private audit (Dec 1, 2025) and Cantina private audit (Aug 1, 2025) for afiUSD contracts. Provides audit report links and responsible disclosure program details.
Docs homepage describes AFI as Proof-of-Reserve infrastructure for RWAs with mission to verify tokenized assets. Lists governance, audits, and other resources.

GitHub organization with 3 public repositories: afiUSD (ERC4626 yield vault), por-proof-verifier-script (TypeScript), and pendle-external-integration (fork). Organization profile shows no public member information.

Detailed smart contract repository with Solidity source code for ERC4626-compliant vault. Architecture includes afiToken, Manager, Yield, and Proxy contracts. README documents functionality and flows but does not list deployed addresses or contain broadcast/ or deployments/ artifacts.

unknowns: D2: deployed_contracts_doc not accessible; referenced URL https://docs.afiprotocol.ai/technical-details/contract-addresses unreachable
D4: GitHub deployment artifacts (broadcast/ or deployments/ directories) not found in afiUSD repo at main branch
D5: Monad chain status unclear; not standard EVM chain; cannot verify deployments on unknown chain
D1-onchain: Etherscan name-tag search returned no AFI Protocol contract addresses; additional per-chain explorer searches blocked by 0 fetch budget remaining

protocol_metadata.about: AFI Protocol builds Proof-of-Reserve infrastructure for Real-World Assets (RWAs), enabling transparent, auditable yield generation across DeFi. Users deposit stablecoins into afiUSD vaults to earn institutional-grade yield through risk-aware, algorithmic capital management strategies. The protocol features cross-chain yield distribution, withdrawal cooldowns, and multi-protocol asset deployment coordinated by off-chain agents.
